profile.headline: Software Engineer at Snowflake
profile.summary: Results-driven Software Engineer with a strong background in designing and implementing enterprise level applications. Specialized in designing and developing and supporting cloud-based distributed systems with an emphasis on efficiency, performance, and automation. Experience working on AI, Privacy and Infrastructure teams at scale. Unrestricted ability to work in United States and Europe.
